task: cover the 2nd motor rifle company from low-flying attack on its move east to the Kesmark bridges, keeping behind it
short_ru: прикрыть 2-ю мотострелковую роту от ударов с малых высот при выдвижении к мостам Кесмарк
reasons: The company takes over the bridges' close defence from the west.
On the road it has no cover of its own against low attack.
The enemy has struck columns on the Lazne road twice since the war began.

situation.text: strike aircraft low along the Rava valley and over the Lazne road
helicopters along the river's south bank

habits: The enemy comes at dawn and at dusk, low, and hunts columns on the roads.

area.notes: The company's assembly area west of the bridges: the battery forms behind it there, then keeps behind it as it moves.

readiness_text: no. 1 while the company is on the move

limits.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 232-239 (covering troops: the battery 1.5-3 km behind the covered companies); pvo_bu_ix_1984 (search and fire on the senior commander's designation, or independently); the choice of designation for this order is the campaign's
limits.notes: Track O, O4: the leash is the held map's leash_m (data/gameplay/held_map.json); the launchers fire on the battery commander's designation only.

coordination: the company's net (the covered unit's, FuG-2): its call sign Клён
call signs and frequencies as the communications diagram
reports: «к бою готов» to the regiment's command post by radio on arrival
each move after the company, with its new place
source: sam3d: a fictional order in the form of voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 240-245 (the working map's contents) for covering troops (pp. 232-239); the reasons and the situation are the campaign's
notes: Track O, O4's mission: the company the battery covers moves on after the battery has formed behind it; the battery commander knows where it is only from its reports on its net or by seeing it, and keeps the battery within the leash of it.
